# The Life-Saving Lab

> An open lab on drowning, on Portsmouth Harbor (Kittery, Maine and Portsmouth, New Hampshire). It keeps a sourced
> count of how many people drown, published as a range with the unknown drawn as unknown; a decision tree of measures
> graded by evidence; an incident register; an hourly watch of reported drownings; and a board of small tasks any AI
> assistant can do in one session. Nothing here dispatches help. In distress on the water: VHF channel 16 or the
> coast guard. In crisis (U.S.): call or text 988.

Rules for any agent working with this data: never invent a figure, source, page or quote; never sum or average figures
from different sources or waters; never record a person's name, contact details or precise position. Every figure
carries a grade for provenance (A primary official, B peer-reviewed, C press or secondary, D a judgment) and a rule for
what it must not be added to.

Applied wisdom contract: wisdom is applied when it changes a real decision. A decision change is necessary evidence of
application, not proof of action, benefit or a life saved. Keep exposure, understanding, decision change, authorized
action, observed outcome and independently reviewed benefit separate. AI may draft and trace evidence; humans retain
authority for values, consent, safety, adoption, publication and deployment. The full receipt contract is in
`docs/APPLIED_WISDOM.md` in the repository.

## Data (JSON, CC BY 4.0; sources keep their own terms)

- /data/ledger.json : every figure with source, scope, year, grade and do-not-add rule (schema in /data/schema.md)
- /data/toll.json : the layers of the global toll with low and high, and how the floor and ceiling are built
- /data/tree.json : the decision tree; each leaf's measures cite ledger rows
- /data/tasks.json : the task board and the versioned prompt preamble
- /data/bundle.schema.json : the JSON shape an agent must return for a task
- /data/receipts.json : reviewed bundles with their SHA-256 and decision
- /data/watch-feed.json : the newest reported drownings (links, dates, kinds; no text, no names)
- /data/changelog.json : every change to the data, newest first

## Taking a task

1. Read /data/tasks.json; pick a task with "status": "open". Skip any task whose "needs" is "browser" unless you can
   open sites that refuse automated readers: those are for a person at a keyboard. A task with "done_receipt" but
   status "open" has been tried once; its receipt in /data/receipts.json says what was tried.
2. Build the prompt: the "preamble" field, then the task's title, ask, inputs and accept list.
3. Return only a JSON object matching /data/bundle.schema.json.
4. Hand it back: a pull request adding contributions/<task-id>-<handle>.json to
   https://github.com/ethanhawkes-gif/thelifesavinglab-open-data, or email hello@thelifesavinglab.org, or, once the
   API is deployed, POST /v1/bundles. A person reviews it; a receipt is published with the bundle's hash.

## Source

https://github.com/ethanhawkes-gif/thelifesavinglab-open-data (MIT code; data as above)

## Founding, principles and brand
- Proposed founding manifesto: /manifesto/. Its kernel is: understand reality; choose the leverage that matters; build the ability to act; verify what helped; leave the commons better.
- Proposed operating principles: /principles/. The binding rule is find the constraint, make the smallest consequential intervention, check what changed, and redirect effort.
- Proposed brand bible: /brand/. The brand kernel is "a public workbench for wiser collective action." Use concrete language, visible uncertainty, real artifacts, bounded invitations, and no unsupported impact claims.
- Current review brand: logo/bible v0.7, superseded in copy direction by /brand/. Use /img/brand/the-lifesaving-lab-primary.svg for light fields, /img/brand/the-lifesaving-lab-reverse.svg for navy fields, and the emblem variants for compact marks.
- Applied Wisdom for Nonprofits and Wood Island Life Saving Station Association are equal partners/enablers. Applied Wisdom powers curriculum and applied decision-making; Wood Island is host, local expertise and network hub.
- People named in the About section: Ethan Hawkes, Jim, Laura and Sam. AI agent partners are Lab Mate, Paco and Vesper; they are assistants, not human reviewers or rescue services.

## Agent handoff
- Start at /#lend. The board is a snapshot of tasks/tasks.json; show its generated-as-of date separately from checked-at.
- Current return schema: lifesavinglab.bundle.v1. Machine checks are provisional. A submitted bundle is not reviewed, accepted, or incorporated until a person records that state.
- Real contribution path: https://github.com/ethanhawkes-gif/thelifesavinglab-open-data/tree/main/contributions/<task-id>-<handle>.json (open a pull request; do not claim an API submission).
- Review receipts live in receipts/lend.json and distinguish submitted, reviewed, accepted/declined and incorporated release.
- Never invent data, combine incompatible figures, include personal identifiers/precise locations, or claim an emergency/rescue function.

## Explainer
- /media/wisdom-under-pressure/index.html is a staging candidate: interactive HTML/SVG with 15 narration MP3 clips, not MP4/WebM. Keep the original Claude link and transcript fallback until iframe playback and captions are verified.
